heading_path: 8.3  Grounds for application for rectification of Register—registered trade mark identical etc to trade mark protected under Madrid Protocol
text: For section 189A of the Act, and in addition to anything in Part 8 of the Act, an application for the rectification of the Register in relation to a trade mark may be made on any of the grounds mentioned in regulation 4.15A. Note: Under subsection 189A(3) of the Act, regulations made for the purposes of section 189A: (a) may be inconsistent with the Act; and (b) prevail over the Act (including any other regulations or other instruments made under the Act), to the extent of any inconsistency.
